text: دل می رود ز دستم صاحب دلان خدا را
دردا که راز پنهان خواهد شد آشکارا
translation: My heart is slipping from my hands, O people of heart, for God's sake!
Alas, my hidden secret is about to be revealed!
note: At its core, the verse captures the vulnerability of losing emotional self-control. Whether interpreted through a mystical lens (divine ecstasy) or a secular one (romantic passion), it depicts the fear and inevitability of having one's deepest, most guarded feelings exposed to the world.
